evidence_slice: OPDC's Board adopted the OPDC Local Plan on 22 June 2022. The OPDC Strategic Site Allocations Viability Assessment identifies Site Allocation 40, North Pole East Depot South, with site area 2.26 hectares, residential mixed use, plan-period homes capacity 750, 750 homes in the 0-10 year London Plan period, and 500 square metres NIA economic floorspace. The official OPDC public policies map FeatureServer layer 25 is named Site Allocations, uses polygon geometry, display field site_name, British National Grid EPSG:27700, and supports JSON, GeoJSON and PBF query formats.
